conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Karen Miller with the IRS Tax Refund Unit. I'm calling regarding your recent federal tax filing. May I speak with Mr. Jameson, please?
Yes, this is Mr. Jameson. Is there something wrong with my taxes?

No, sir, not at all, in fact, our system shows you are eligible for a refund of $2,843 due to a recalculation in your 2022 tax return. This is a part of the federal stimulus corrections. I just need to verify a few details so we can process your IRS refund.
Oh, I wasn't expecting a refund. Are you sure this isn't a mistake?

Absolutely, Mr. Jameson. We are contacting taxpayers who qualify for this adjustment. To proceed, I'll need to confirm your identity and process the standard IRS clearance fee of $98, which is required for the release of all refunds above $2,000.
Clearance fee? I've been on Social Security for several years and never paid a fee for a refund.

I understand your concern, sir. However, this is a new security measure due to increased tax fraud. The IRS will not issue the stimulus refund without this verification step. The fee is fully refundable and will be added to your total payment.
I really need that money, but I'm not sure I can pay a fee right now. Is there another way?

Unfortunately, if the fee isn't processed within 24 hours, your refund will be flagged as unclaimed. That could cause delays of up to six months, and the IRS may review your Social Security benefit eligibility. Let's not risk that.
Oh dear, I can't have my Social Security delayed. What do I need to do?
To expedite your refund, you can clear the $98 fee today. You may pay using a credit or debit card, or by purchasing a pre-paid card if that's easier for you. Which method works best?
I don't use credit cards much, but I can get a prepaid card from the store, I suppose.

Perfect, Mr. Jameson. Please go to your nearest pharmacy or supermarket and purchase a GreenDot or Visa/Mastercard prepaid card for $98. When you have the card, call this number and provide the code on the back. This will allow us to verify your identity and release your refund.
So I have to go out and buy a card for $98, then call you back with the numbers?

Yes, sir, that's correct. It's a quick and secure process. Please don't delay, as the IRS will initiate a flag on your file if the payment is not received by 5 p.m. today. This could result in a suspension of your Medicare coverage pending further review.
Suspension of Medicare? That sounds serious. I can go now, but how will I know this is all legitimate?

I understand your concern. You can validate my badge number, IR-345872, on the IRS refund hotline if you wish. But please remember, if we don't receive confirmation today, your refund and benefits could be delayed or affected.
Alright, I'll go to the store and get the prepaid card. Should I call back to this same number?

Exactly, Mr. Jameson. Call this number as soon as you have the card. Have both the prepaid card and your Social Security number ready for immediate verification. We must process this before the IRS system closes your case today.
